local_change: Start from original adapter composite rules with accuracy>=.85. Require accuracy improvement over the best constant, individual variable or negation to reach a positive margin, with1e-12 tolerance. For every pair of initially eligible rules whose target is in the other's source list, veto the lower-accuracy target; if accuracies tie within tolerance, veto both. Return initially eligible targets minus all vetoed targets. This is a simultaneous pairwise conflict veto, not a DAG search, new memory update or causal direction guarantee.
development_selection: Reuse the16 development seeds already used by the failed increment-only design; disclose this adaptive design step. For both budgets require clean OR, identity and noise10 physical BA no lower than original memory (numeric tolerance only), zero physical suppression in these conditions, noise10 direct BA loss<=.01 versus threshold-only memory and FPR increase<=.02. Among passing margins maximize average budget4 direct BA across six conditions minus noise10 budget8 FPR. Tie in grid order. If none passes, choose smallest summed guard violation, then largest objective, and mark failure. Independently tune the tree over original, calibrated, all increment-only and all conflict settings using its own same objective.
confirmation_criteria: Use all48 still-unseen seeds with frozen selections. Evaluate the same retention guards and report failures. Require higher noise10 budget4 direct BA than both shared-filter and independently tuned trees; report paired95% intervals. Readout FPR ties are ties. Exact-copy success is retention without claiming orientation or zero readout FPR.
fairness: Same raw records, observed contexts, round information, histories, candidate variables and interaction budgets for all learners. Shared-filter baselines receive exactly the same target-suppression mask as memory. Trees retain all raw input features; the core excludes suppressed variables from its state. This stronger input interface for trees is preserved. An independently tuned tree selects from eight filter settings on development only. No gold roles, query answers, condition name, seed or true noise probability is passed to the filter.
scope: Same six finite conditions, four rounds and supplied diagnostic schedule. All prior failed results retained. No change to original CausalCore, observation module, IdentityMemory or manuscript. Conflict resolution is empirical predictive filtering; it does not identify causal direction for arbitrary physical mediators or latent confounders.
statistics: Average rounds within seed, then paired seed bootstrap with10000 resamples and seed117419.48 independent generator seeds, not48 unrelated task families. All six conditions reported; confirmatory targets fixed before these outcomes, additional comparisons descriptive. No outcome-based stopping.
